magnitude_policy: Report native-unit and relative changes, paired-query tails, and gains/losses within each category. Do not average different metrics or treat category win counts as an overall quality score. Ratios at zero baselines are undefined. These are descriptive validation comparisons, not confidence or paper-parity claims.
